name: Konno Yuuko
source:
She is the homeroom teacher of Koudai's class. She is a new teacher. She is beautiful and is popular among her students.

She is surprised to learn about Koudai's research project and is asked by him to join.

She is motherly but weak in the face of pressure.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/LRG/lrg_info.html]Official site[/url]]
